subject: Pilot kickoff decision log — scope, KPIs, and access next steps
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@cavanai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposed pilot scope (next steps)

Hi Elena / Austin — thanks again for a productive call today. I wanted to capture what we heard and lay out a concrete pilot kickoff plan so we can align on owners and timeline. Please review and flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you confirmed
- Frequent incorrect entity extraction and hallucinated attributes in support summarization flows.
- High cost per token for current third-party API and inconsistent latency during peak hours.
- Need for deterministic accuracy on a 6–8 field extraction schema (customer, product, issue_category, priority, timestamp, resolution_summary).

Pilot goal (success criteria)
- Reduce entity extraction F1 false positives by >= 20% vs your current baseline on the 30k prompt eval set.
- Serve 95th percentile latency < 350ms for 1–2 concurrent inference pipelines.
- Demonstrate a 30% unit-cost reduction via batching + KV-prefix caching in production-like workload.

Proposed pilot scope (4 weeks)
- Week 0 (prep, security & access): exchange security docs, account provisioning, and SSO test user. (Deliverable: access worksheet)
- Week 1 (data ingest & prompt set): ingest 10k redacted support conversations, Redwood to produce an initial prompt suite + prompt engineering checklist. (Deliverable: prompt_set_v0.json)
- Week 2 (eval & tuning): run automated evals, iterate on prompt templates and quantization profile. (Deliverable: eval_report_week2.pdf)
- Week 3 (pilot run & handoff): 72-hour production-like run, cost/latency dashboard, and final recommendations. (Deliverable: pilot-run-summary.docx)

Owners (proposed)
- Redwood: Priyom (AE) — overall coordination; Karthik (SE) — infra/setup and prompt engineering; Marissa (CS) — success metrics and adoption plan.
- CavanAI: Elena — product owner; Austin — infra/security contact; engineering lead TBD.

Immediate asks from CavanAI
1) Confirm pilot sponsor and engineering point-of-contact.
2) Share the redacted sample dataset or grant read access to the S3 bucket (details in access-worksheet.csv attachment).
3) Confirm tolerance for token retention / logs (we discussed 30 days vs 90 days).

Attachments: pilot-charter-draft.pdf, access-worksheet.csv, cavanai-security-questions.pdf

Proposed kickoff window: Thu May 6 — Mon May 10 (we recommend May 7 or 10). Are you available for a 60-minute kickoff on either date?

Thanks — will stand up the Drive folder and DocuSign for the pilot charter once we have confirmation.

—
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Elena Park <elena@cavanai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Austin Kim <austin.kim@cavanai.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed pilot scope (next steps)

Thanks Priyom — this looks great and matches our internal notes. A few clarifications before we lock dates: 

1) Engineering POC — confirmed: that will be Austin (cc'd). He'll be the person to provision the S3 read-only access.
2) Data redaction — we'll share a redacted sample (5k rows) for Week 1. For the pilot run we expect to allow a second batch of 25k redacted items if the initial run looks good.
3) Retention policy — security wants logs retained for 90 days in the pilot environment; are you able to support that for the short-run?
4) SOC2 evidence — I'm attaching our vendor intake questionnaire (inside cavanai-security-questions.pdf). Can you share a contact on the Redwood side for SOC2/Security questions?

Kickoff: May 7 at 10:00 AM PT works for us for a 60-min kickoff. Please send calendar invite.

Also: on success criteria, the 20% F1 improvement is acceptable as long as the baseline numbers use our defined evaluation labels (we'll send a short scoring rubric).

Elena
Elena Park
Head of Product | CavanAI
elena@cavanai.com

- Create prompt_set_v0: 100 prompt templates covering the 6–8 extraction fields; include positive/negative examples.
- Build an eval harness that can run the 5k sample (metric: F1 by field) and export week1_eval.csv.
- Confirm memory/throughput on the temporary cluster and validate 95th percentile latency target.

Marissa (CS) — priority items- Draft Success Criteria doc in Drive (use the starter I created).
- Prepare the pilot-run acceptance checklist and the adoption playbook stub.
- Coordinate with Lindsey (security@redwood.com) to ensure SOC2 intake responses are delivered by EOD May 6.

Other logistics
- I'll upload the pilot-charter-draft.pdf and access-worksheet.csv to the Drive folder and forward the DocuSign link for the charter.
- Austin will provide S3 read-only details during the kickoff; ensure the provisioning checklist includes the IAM ARN.

If you see any blockers, call me directly. Otherwise I'll mark these as owners in the pilot Jira epic (RDW-8472-PILOT) after the kickoff.

Priyom
